a.address: Pedro de Alba 232, Iztaccihuatl, Benito Juárez, 03520 CDMX
a.address_statement: How to get here • Pedro de Alba 232, Iztaccihuatl, Benito Juárez, 03520 CDMX
a.notes: Source is the Mexico City government venue listing, titled 'Biquini Wax EPS' (Spanish spelling of 'Bikini'). Name, city and country match, but only the one listing was found and the search text does not describe the venue type. The first search returned only unrelated Fresha waxing-salon directories. No institution website is on file for this record. Address is written as the source writes it; the district name is spelled 'Iztaccihuatl' in the source.

Two searches (one by name and city, one by name plus the domain cracvalparaiso.org) found no street address. TransArtists and a 2014 Chilean culture ministry item describe CRAC Valparaíso as a residency centre, but no result gives a street address; the listing only says a room in the historic district. The second search returned unrelated namesakes (Cámara Regional del Comercio in Valparaíso, the Argentine consulate). The first returned the Centre Régional d'Art Contemporain in Sète, France, which is not this institution. The official site was not returned.

a.address_statement: The current address is Coolhaven 32, 3024 AC Rotterdam. TENT moved there from its old location, so the older Witte de Withstraat 50 address in some listings is out of date.
a.notes: Street and number (Coolhaven 32) are consistent across results, but the postcode conflicts. The search text gives 3024 AC, while one result title (go-kids.nl, https://go-kids.nl/rotterdam/erop-uit/tent-in-rotterdam) reads 'Coolhaven 32, 3024 BK Rotterdam'. I used AC because it is stated in the search text and the museum.nl listing is the better source, but the postcode is unconfirmed. The search text does not tie the address sentence to a single URL; museum.nl/en/tent (titled 'Opening hours, address and telephone number') is the most likely origin. The official tentrotterdam.nl site was not returned in either search. TENT moved from Witte de Withstraat 50 after about 25 years, so that address is outdated and was not used.

a.address_statement: Address Eendrachtsstraat 10 3012 XL Rotterdam the Netherlands
a.notes: Street and number are consistent across results; the postcode conflicts. One listing gives 3012 XL and another gives 3012 BN. The Leiden University event pages for exhibitions in the V2_ gallery space use 3012 XL, which is why XL was chosen. The search text does not say which of the two TransArtists pages states the address; the results list both of them. The official v2.nl contact page was not returned, so the postcode is unconfirmed by the institution itself.

a.address_statement: The current address appears to be Dijksgracht 6, 1019 BS Amsterdam, at the Dijkspark waterside location. The Artstalk listing gives Dijksgracht 6 with the Dijkspark name and the same phone number.
a.notes: Official mediamatic.net contact page was not retrieved; the address comes from an art-magazine listing (Artstalk), and a Prospeo profile also places the headquarters there. Both searches called it the most consistently reported address. Other addresses in the results look like older locations or registry entries: Vijzelstraat 66-80 (Time Out), Vijzelstraat 72 (Virtual Shoe Museum, tied to the earlier Mediamatic Bank), VOC-kade 10 (Sygic), and Isaac Titsinghkade 101 (OpenCorporates, for an inactive company 'Mediatic Media' that may be a different entity). Mediamatic has moved between several Amsterdam locations over the years, so confirm against the official site.

No street address found. Sonic Acts is an Amsterdam organisation, but neither search returned an office address; the sonicacts.com/about page snippet has a billing-address section that cut off before the street address (KvK number 34198520 given, which could be used to look up the registered address). The 2026 Biennial ran across about 15 venues (W139, Arti et Amicitiae, Rozenstraat and others), so there is no single public venue. Older editions were at Paradiso, Weteringschans 6-8, 1017 SG Amsterdam, per 2008 and 2017 event pages, which is the festival's host venue and not the organisation's own premises. Left empty.

a.address_statement: OT301 is at Overtoom 301, 1054 JL Amsterdam. The exact postal address is Overtoom 301, 1054 JL Amsterdam, Netherlands, according to Tixel's listing.
a.notes: Source is a ticketing listing (Tixel), not the official site; the official ot301.nl contact page was not returned by search. Other listings in the results (In Your Pocket, Bonjour Amsterdam, Wikipedia) are about the same venue and give the same context, but their snippets did not restate the address line. OT301 is a former-squat building run by the association Vereniging EHBK (Eerste Hulp Bij Kunst), which bought it from the council in 2006.

a.address_statement: Kunsthal Gent is at Vrouwebroersstraat 6, 9000 Gent, according to a volunteer-platform listing.
a.notes: Source is the giveaday.be volunteer-platform page for Kunsthal Gent vzw, not the institution's own site; the official kunsthal.gent contact page and the visit.gent listing appeared in results but their snippets did not restate the address. The venue is the former Carmelite monastery (Caermersklooster) in central Ghent, taken over by the city in 2018 and named Kunsthal Gent. It is open mainly at weekends and by appointment on other days, per the visit.gent listing.

a.address_statement: KIOSK is at Louis Pasteurlaan 2, 9000 Ghent. (Earlier search, e-flux listing: "KIOSK exhibit, Louis Pasteurlaan 2, Ghent 9000, Belgium.")
a.notes: Two searches done. The e-flux directory text gives the address explicitly with the postcode written as 'Ghent 9000, Belgium'. The kiosk.art contact page (club.kiosk.art/contact) appeared in the results and the search text gives the same address ('Louis Pasteurlaan 2, 9000 Ghent'), though the text does not say which page states it. The site is on the Bijloke campus, in a former anatomical theatre.

a.address_statement: CIAP is a contemporary art centre at C-mine in Genk, Belgium. Address: C-mine 10, bus 1, 3600 Genk (from the archived practical info page, which lists the same address on its homepage).
a.notes: Two searches done. The address comes from the institution's archived website (archive.ciap.be), which the search itself calls several years old. The current pages (ciap.be/visit-us, ciap.be/about) appeared in the Links but their text was not returned, so the address was not confirmed on the live site. Recheck against ciap.be/visit-us. Do not confuse with the Genk visitor information office, which is at C-mine 10 bus 2 (a different organisation), or with Memorial University's CIAP (Canada).

a.address_statement: Museum Abteiberg is at Abteistraße 27 / Johannes-Cladders-Platz, 41061 Mönchengladbach. (Earlier search: "The museum's address is Abteistraße 27, 41061 Mönchengladbach, Germany. Sources agree on this, including a German event-travel PDF that gives the same street address.")
a.notes: Two searches done. The two official-site URLs (contact and travel directions) appeared in the results, but the search text does not say which of them states the address line. The third URL is a German federal agency PDF of directions that the first search said gives the same street address. One source writes the street as 'Abteistraße 27 / Johannes-Cladders-Platz'. Driving access is via the 'Berliner Platz 15' car park. The ticket also covers Museum Schloss Rheydt and TextilTechnikum, which are separate venues; Abteiberg is the main venue for this record.

a.address_statement: The Kestner Gesellschaft is an art association at Goseriede 11, 30159 Hannover.
a.notes: Two searches done. The first (unrestricted) search gave the same address ('The Kestner Gesellschaft's address is Goseriede 11, 30159 Hannover'), so both searches agree. The URLs are the institution's own site pages that appeared in the Links of the second search; the search text does not say which page states the line. Not to be confused with Museum August Kestner, a separate Hannover museum.

a.address_statement: The official address is Schlossplatz 2, 70173 Stuttgart, directly on the Schlossplatz in the city centre.
a.notes: One search used. The result text states the address without saying which link it came from; the two URLs are the institution's own site (wkv-stuttgart.de) and the City of Stuttgart's official address page for the Kunstverein, both returned in the same result. The result also mentions a Kunstgebäude page on stuttgart.de, which is the building, not a separate venue. Phone and fax numbers differ between museum.de and the Kunstverein's own site; not relevant to the address.

a.address_statement: The official site lists the address as Villa Salve Hospes, Lessingplatz 12, 38100 Braunschweig, with phone 0531 – 49556 and email info[at]kunstvereinbraunschweig.de.
a.notes: One search used. Source is the institution's own Visit page. Other results (braunschweig.de, museum.de, 9staedte.de) concern the same Villa Salve Hospes. Opening hours differ between the official site and an older 9staedte.de listing; not relevant to the address.

a.address_statement: HMKV's exhibition space is at the Dortmunder U, level 3, Leonie-Reygers-Terrasse, D-44137 Dortmund, with the general address info@hmkv.de.
a.notes: Two searches used. The address is the exhibition space, from an older page of hmkv.de (the page title is 'Exhibition Space'); the source writes it as 'Dortmunder U, level 3, Leonie-Reygers-Terrasse, D-44137 Dortmund', and 'Ebene 3' above is my German rendering of 'level 3', so the literal source form is 'Dortmunder U, level 3, Leonie-Reygers-Terrasse, D-44137 Dortmund'. A more recent local arts listing, as summarised by the search, says the Hartware MedienKunstVerein becomes the Kunsthalle Dortmund at the same Dortmunder U address, with a temporary closure for space transformation before reopening; I could not confirm the new name or the closure on an official page, so check before publishing. Office addresses are different from the public venue: Park der Partnerstädte 2, 44137 Dortmund (medienwerk.nrw office hosted by HMKV, and a job posting); Hoher Wall 15, 44137 Dortmund appears in 2022 notices and looks outdated.

a.address_statement: The Halle für Kunst Steiermark is at Burgring 2, 8010 Graz, in the Stadtpark.
a.notes: Two searches used. The sources are the regional tourism board (steiermark.com) and the Graz tourism site, listed under the English title 'House of Arts & Media'; the result text identifies the listing as Halle für Kunst Steiermark. The institution's own domain (halle-fuer-kunst.at) did not appear in either search, so the address is not confirmed against the institution's site. Other steiermark.com links in the results are language or snapshot copies of the same listing.

a.address_statement: The Grazer Kunstverein is at Palais Trauttmansdorff, Burggasse 4, 8010 Graz, Austria.
a.notes: The search result text gives the address as a summary and does not tie it to one link. The URLs listed are the official site pages and the e-flux directory entry from the same result set. A 2007 e-flux announcement used the older form Bürgergasse 4/II, and current listings use Burggasse. The phone number differs between sources, but it is not needed here.

a.address_statement: The Salzburger Kunstverein is at the Künstlerhaus, Hellbrunner Straße 3, 5020 Salzburg, Austria.
a.notes: The first URL is the institution's own visitor information page. The Falter listing is a secondary source in the same result set. The result text does not tie the address to one specific link. The Künstlerhaus has housed the Kunstverein since 1885.

a.address_statement: The Kunsthalle Friart Fribourg is at Petites-Rames 22, 1700 Fribourg, in the lower town, and the official site lists free admission.
a.notes: The result text says the official site gives the postal form Petites-Rames 22, CP 294, CH-1701 Fribourg. 1701 and CP 294 are the postal box postcode, and 1700 is the street postcode. One museums.ch listing gives Kleinrahmengasse 22, a German-language street name, which the result text calls an apparent error. The result text does not tie the address to one specific link.

a.address_statement: CAN Centre d'art Neuchâtel is at Rue des Moulins 37, 2000 Neuchâtel, Switzerland.
a.notes: The result text says the most detailed address source is a 2025 exhibition handout, a contemporaryartlibrary.org PDF. It does not tie the address to one specific link. The URLs given are the institution's own site page and a tourism listing from the same result set. The Neuchâtel tourism site j3l.ch describes the centre as in the old town.

a.address_statement: Iniva's official site lists its office at 16 John Islip Street, London SW1P 4JU. (Second search: Iniva is at 16 John Islip Street, London SW1P 4JU, per the UK Charity Commission register entry for the Institute of International Visual Arts.)
a.notes: Official site and Charity Commission register agree on John Islip Street. Older listings (Time Out, a Wikipedia-style mirror) still give the former home at Rivington Place, Shoreditch (EC2A 3BA), which looks outdated and is not used. The results describe this address as the office; the Stuart Hall Library there has its own public hours (Tuesday to Friday, 10am to 5pm). Pages differ on whether the building is Block D or Block E of the UAL campus.

a.address_statement: The CCA (Centre for Contemporary Arts) is at 350 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow G2 3JD. (First search: The CCA is at 350 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow G2 3JD, on the corner with Scott Street.)
a.notes: The address line comes from the result text summarising the CCA's own visit page plus The Skinny listing. Not to be confused with CCA Global Limited, a different Glasgow organisation at 20 Newton Place. Opening hours differ between sources (not recorded). A Cryptic listing mentions access disruption after a fire in the area and Sauchiehall Street redevelopment, possibly out of date; current opening status was not confirmed.

a.address_statement: Tramway is at 25 Albert Drive, Glasgow G41 2PE, in the Pollokshields area on the south side of Glasgow.
a.notes: Single venue. Address comes from the result for Tramway's own visit page (tramway.org/visit-us), and a second listing carries the same address in its URL title. Sources disagree on the phone number (not recorded).

a.address_statement: The CCA is at 10–12 Artillery Street, Derry~Londonderry, BT48 6RG. (Second search: The venue is at 10-12 Artillery Street, BT48 6RG, Derry~Londonderry.)
a.notes: The institution's own site (ccadld.org) did not appear in either search; the address rests on Visit Derry (official tourism site), the OpenCharities record and Euan's Guide, which agree. Euan's Guide gives the email domain cca-derry-londonderry.org while the charity record gives ccadld.org, so the organisation may use more than one domain. Not confirmed on the institution's own page.

a.address_statement: The charity register lists 6 Joy's Entry, Belfast, BT1 4DR. A 2026 exhibition listing also places the gallery at 6 joys entry, Belfast.
a.notes: Line is from the WebSearch result text, which attributes the address to the charity register entry (Catalyst Arts Ltd, opencharities.uk) and a 2026 exhibition listing. The result also mentioned an outdated 2012 listing at 5 College Court, Belfast BT1 6BS, which the result itself marks as superseded; not used. The institution's own site (catalystarts.org.uk) was returned but the displayed text did not quote an address from it.

a.address_statement: Council records give it as 9-10 Patrick Street, Limerick, and an older listing refers to Nos.9-11 Patrick St.
a.notes: No postcode (Eircode) found in the results. Sources disagree on the number range: council records say 9-10 Patrick Street, an older listing (archiseek) says Nos.9-11 Patrick St. The result text does not say which of the two limerick.ie pages carries the line, so both are listed. Ormston House's own website was not returned in the search; no contact page seen. Treat as medium confidence and re-check against ormstonhouse.com.
